prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 mean temperature 36.0 °C (within 1% of healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.5 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.38 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.89 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 391 W·min/l (within 2% of healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 6.53 l/min (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.3 % (2% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
